svg.title: How Irreplaceable works
svg.desc: How Irreplaceable works, in five steps. 1 Your job: type a job title or drop a resume, no sign-up. 2 Week map: every task sorted into AI does it, AI speeds it up, stays yours. 3 12-week plan: three to five actions a week from your own tasks. 4 Daily reps: Spot the slip, Delegate, Human edge, ten minutes a day. 5 Proof: a score that moves with practice and a dated proof page. Free covers the week map with its PDF report, AI or me? and one trial rep; Pro ($19 a month or $119 a year) covers daily reps, the plan, skills, proof, points and the shop; Max ($79 a month or $479 a year) adds the AI coach by chat or voice, Playbook, Second look and the Review kit.
